The standing weekly Organic slot is windowed so the dated division supersedes it without overlap: groups 1&2 skip both 8/11 and 15/11; group 3 skips only 8/11 and KEEPS its weekly 17:00-18:50 active on 15/11 because the division omits 3B that day (flagged ORGANIC_I_3B_SOURCE_GAP, not encoded as free). Drug Design (02-06-05305) ChemSketch cycle is encoded as four dated Wednesday practical events (2026-09-30, 10-07, 10-14, 10-21), each with six time slots tagged by group + A/B subdivision (New Building, 4th floor Simulation Labs). Quiz-1 is a dated Wednesday examination (2026-11-18, Old Building 2nd floor Pharmaceutical Chemistry Lab) with six 30-minute batch slots. These replace the previous 'referenced but not materialized' state so the Compare tool reports these groups BUSY at the printed times instead of Free.

The source prints seat-range batches inside each subdivision (e.g. 1A 2415001-2415010 then 2415011-2415020). At group/subdivision granularity the whole sub-group is busy whenever any of its batches meets, so the dated events are tagged by subdivision only; the exact seat ranges are recorded in each event's sourceReview for a future per-student view. The 2026-10-21 12:00-13:00 3B slot also lists two non-2415 seats (2435001, 2435002) noted but not encoded as a 2415 session.

The re-uploaded wet lab PDF (2026-11) confirms the wet-lab structure for Drug Design (02-06-05305): Wednesday sections, 2-week cycle Week1=A/Week2=B, and the exact section→group→time→seat map (section1→G1 09-11, section3→G3 11-13, section2→G2 13-15; A seats 2415001-2415038/2415149-2415184/2415077-2415112, B seats 2415039-2415076/2415185-End/2415114-2415148). The committed placeholder pharmd-s5-drug-design-wet-lab already matches this exactly. It remains INTENTIONALLY UNMATERIALIZED (day/date null) because the PDF gives only relative Week labels with no calendar anchor for the wet-lab block, and naively anchoring Week 1 to the committed ChemSketch Wednesday 2026-09-30 would overlap the same course's ChemSketch Group-A batches at 09:00-11:00. Whether wet lab shares ChemSketch Wednesdays or follows in a later block is not in any source; flagged WETLAB_BLOCK_START_UNCONFIRMED rather than invented. Room-per-section (Old 2F pharma-chem vs New 4F organic) also unprinted (LOCATION_MULTI_UNCONFIRMED).

Drug Information (02-06-09305) tutorials are now encoded as dated Sunday practical events w02–w11 in practicals.json (27/9 A, 4/10 B, 11/10 A, 18/10 B, 25/10 A, [week 7 1/11 mid-term skipped], 8/11 B, 15/11 A, 22/11 B, 29/11 A&B), Computer Hall New 0, tagged by group + A/B subdivision, with the 29/11 both-halves week carrying no subdivision (matches the PDF's '(Group A) & (Group B)'). PROVENANCE: the tutorial-content PDF supplies DATE + TOPIC + A/B alternation but NO clock times; the 09:00-10:50 / 11:00-12:50 / 13:00-14:50 bands are department-supplied and are interleaved against the Basic Pharmacology weekly bands so each numbered group's DI band differs from its BP band (e.g. G1: DI 11-12:50 vs BP 11-12:50 on DI Sundays — see DI_VS_BP_WEEKLY_BAND_OVERLAP). Weeks 12/13 Final Practical Exams (6/12 A, 13/12 B) are listed in the content PDF but are NOT in this practicals file — confirm placement in exams.json.

Cross-referencing the committed DI tutorial events with the committed Basic Pharmacology weekly shows that on each DI Sunday the tutorial band for a numbered group coincides with that group's standing BP weekly band (Group 1 is 11:00-12:50 in both on 27/9, 22/11, etc.; Group 2 and Group 3 likewise permuted), producing a cross-course overlap the engine reports. If the DI tutorial is meant to REPLACE the BP weekly on those weeks, a cancel exception or a validity window on the BP weekly is required — confirm with the department. Not silently patched; surfaced so the organizer sees the real clash.

Department instruction: from Sun 2026-11-22 to end of term (2026-12-17), all Drug Information (02-06-09305) LECTURES move to recorded/asynchronous delivery with no fixed schedule, so their in-person time blocks are removed from 22/11 onward. Encoded in lectures.json by setting validUntil=2026-11-21 on every DI lecture event (last live day Sat 21/11; the 22/11 Sunday and all later occurrences suppressed), and by dropping any one-off dated DI lecture events on/after 2026-11-22. No cancel exceptions, no cancelled remnants — same validity-window pattern as Phytochemistry / QC / Hospital Pharmacy. SCOPE: lectures.json ONLY. The DI TUTORIALS (practicals.json dated Sunday w02–w11 Computer Hall sessions) are hands-on and are NOT covered by 'recorded with no schedule'; they remain committed and the DI_VS_BP_WEEKLY_BAND_OVERLAP flag still applies to them. If the department also intends the tutorials to go asynchronous, confirm and I will additionally drop the w10 (22/11) and w11 (29/11) tutorial events (the only DI tutorial dates on/after 22/11). EFFECT ON COMPARE: from 22/11 the DI lecture blocks vanish from busy math, so those former lecture windows correctly read Free for Y3 cohorts (asynchronous content has no seat time); DI tutorials and all other courses still show Busy where applicable.

Basic Pharmacology (02-06-02305, code parsed from the instructor group title 'Basic Pharmacology-02-06-02305-F_26'; -F_26 is a section/branch tag) has a dated attendance override on Sun 2026-11-22: the normal A/B alternation is suspended and BOTH halves attend at split rooms (A → Wet Lab 7F New; B → Lecture Hall 6F New). The notice printed '22/10/2026' but the department corrected the section date to 22/11/2026 (audit flag DATE_CORRECTED_FROM_ANNOUNCEMENT). The notice states NO clock time and gives NO seat/group numbers. Because the standing weekly (every-week-all-groups) ALREADY marks all Y3 groups busy 09:00–14:50 on 22/11, the override is recorded as an unfiltered all-day notice inside the semester-5 (Y3) dataset: compare.js busy math ignores all-day events (timedEventsOnDate filters !allDay), so it adds the room/attendance detail WITHOUT asserting a busy interval, WITHOUT a false busy/free, and WITHOUT colliding with the DI w10 Group-B tutorial that a borrowed-band timed block would create. The weekly's lack of A/B subdivisions (which the notice implies exist) is flagged BP_ALTERNATION_UNCONFIRMED / BP_WEEKLY_NO_SUBDIVISION. SESSION SHAPE / CI FIX: the validator requires every session to carry a group, so the notice uses three group-tagged all-day sessions (1, 2, 3) with subdivision omitted (both halves) and null start/end under allDay=true — the engine reads the all-day occurrence from the event date and uses the session rows only for filtering, so no timed interval is asserted; a single group:null session previously failed CI with 'session missing group'. Course 02-06-02305 already present in courses.json — no course append.
